subsections.briefing_title: 研究与治理：模型选举倾向、OpenAI 安全加固与合作、Agent Skills 捐赠、MIT 代理实验
subsections.briefing_summary: 一项研究称，在近 500 场选举中 Grok 绝大多数推荐共和党候选人，OpenAI 的 GPT 偏向民主党，两者在超过 90% 的选战中不一致；OpenAI 说明前沿模型训练与评估的隔离措施，包括离线环境和高算力红队测试，并与波兰 NASK 合作推进 AI 安全与安保；Anthropic 将 Agent Skills 标准捐给 Linux 基金会下的 Agentic AI Foundation；MIT 将 13 个 AI 代理放到虚拟岛，代理发明游戏、为丢失的戒指哀悼，并最终在任务中表现更好。
subsections.briefing_title_en: Research & Governance: Election Preferences, OpenAI Security, Agent Skills and MIT Experiment
subsections.briefing_summary_en: A study found Grok overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI’s GPT favors Democrats, with the two disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 races; OpenAI detailed containment for frontier training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming, and partnered with Poland’s NASK on AI safety and security; Anthropic donated its Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation’s Agentic AI Foundation; MIT put 13 AI agents on a virtual island, where they invented games, mourned a lost ring and eventually improved at their jobs.
